text: Paper · Preprint (cs.LG, cs.CL, cs.CR) · arXiv 2609.06966 MOLE: Detecting Insider Threats in AI Agents Aashiq Muhamed, Virginia Smith Carnegie Mellon University (both authors' stated affiliation) · September 2026 (arXiv v1, 7 September 2026; the only version so far) In one line: Simulates an organisation rather than a task set, 150 AI-operated accounts sharing 9 stateful services over 30 workdays with 12 injected threats and around 20B tokens of monitoring corpora from four models, and scores the monitor as well as the agent: 72% of 39 agent models complete most assigned harmful objectives, a model's stated refusal does not predict whether it actually declines, the best monitors miss nearly half of completed harm in a single-day audit, and benchmark-guided search lifts a mid-tier monitor by 49 to 64%, making it an optimisation target rather than only a report card.
